description: Duplicate ads while keeping their social proof (likes, comments, shares) by reusing the same Page post. Only use this when the user asks to keep engagement; for regular duplication use ads_duplicate. Preview existing Meta ads selected by Page post ID without creating anything. Use postIds for discovery or adIds for exact selection, never both. Preview returns sourceCandidates and a pinned resolvedRequest. Ambiguous matches require explicit adIds; warned live runs require acknowledgeWarnings:true or useCreativeId:true. Returns a cleaned source-to-destination plan and never exposes raw Meta payloads.

name.description: Name or name pattern. Ad set names support {AdName} and {Index}.

accountId.description: Meta ad account ID, e.g. act_123.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Explicitly continue after reviewing preview creative warnings. Required for warned live runs unless useCreativeId is true.

adIds.description: Ordered exact source ad IDs. Use preview.resolvedRequest to retain the reviewed selection; exclusive with postIds.

adNamePattern.description: New ad name pattern. Supports {AdName} and {Index}.

adSetId.description: Required for an existing destination ad set. Optional with newAdSet/newAdSetPerAd: omit to copy the source ad set, or provide a template in campaignId and the selected account. A source without its own budget requires a destination template when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets.

confirmSpend.description: Accepted for older clients and ignored: post-ID copies never require it.

newAdSet.description: One shared new ad set. Cannot be combined with newAdSetPerAd.

newAdSetPerAd.description: One new ad set per source ad. Cannot be combined with newAdSet; one source produces one shared clone.

postIds.description: Discover source ads by Page post ID. Multiple matches require an explicit adIds selection; exclusive with adIds.

reason.description: One short note for the user explaining why (shown in their Agent Inbox).

reviewId.description: Add this copy to an existing review from ads_edit_preview or an earlier duplicate, so one run is approved together.

runTitle.description: Short name for this run. If the user names the run, use their exact words. Reuse it with the same reviewId. A run the user renamed keeps their name.

useCreativeId.description: Reuse original creative IDs instead of creating post-reference creatives.

name: ads_duplicate_by_post_preview
title: Preview Duplication by Post
